Gifting this to a friend because I heard so many good things!

I purchased the mini version of this to try Unfortunately I was quite disappointed in this item First Tatcha has always been a little iffy with the size of bottlepackaging vs the amount you receive Yes the description clearly states the amount in each item but the large packaging is likely designed to make you feel like you're receiving more than you do Out of all the items I've tried with Tatcha this purchase felt the most egregious When I first received it the bottle is a normal mini size you might expect but incredibly light - there's not much in there Even worse is the dispenser is low quality and doesn't dispense the product correctly Rather than neatly coming out into your palm it's spurts out in different directions and you end up wasting the little product you do have In terms of whether the product works I haven't seen any difference to my skin It performs like any moisturizer
Nearly have tried all the products My wife loves them Color coded so helps finding the right product
It is very light formula leave my skin soft Im in love with Tatcha brand
With my age I've used many serums and disappointed I didn't try this brand sooner! I've made 2024 the year of my best skin and this serum is a new must for me

Its early for me to comment on the results of using this serum but I do like the overall feel and immediate effect I didnt know there is a shimmer added to it so that was a surprise Since I use it when Im done for the day I dont mind the shimmery bits too much but if youre sensitive to that just take note It does fade a little by the time you wake or its rubbed off as you sleep

I actually received this as a sample with an order I made I love trying new products and Ive been looking for a retinol I turned 31 recently so Ive noticed a couple lines forming in between my eyebrows and my forehead that I dont love I use this 3x a week and Ive noticed a huge difference in my skin The lines are way less noticeable and my skin seriously looks like its back lit I love this product and will definitely be buying the full size when i run out

I enjoy the way it absorbs into my skin and the way my skin looks and feels after I purchased the travel size to test it out on my skin for reactions and so far have had none I do notice a difference in skin appearance and shallower wrinkleslines but again Im only about a week or so into using it in combination with the essence My skin really likes it and I love the thinner consistency of the serum it doesnt feel weird like other serums have on my skin will be purchasing a full size once this runs out

This product feels nice on the skin I got a small size as a sample and have used it for a little more than two weeks I have noticed a smoother looking neck! I do not have mature skin so I don't have much in terms of face wrinkles to review

This product is amazing! I got a sample with my first order and love it even MORE than the dewy serum purchased since I couldnt make up my mind Ive ordered the full size and this will be a part of my nightly ritual moving forward! Thanks Tatcha!

I know everyones skin is different but for my skin this serum plumps hydrates calms soothes brightens clears pores and in the two weeks I have used it I have seen amazing anti-aging affects It is my holy grail and paired with the Indigo line my skin has never looked or felt better I cant live without Tatcha now!

avis.titre: I will never stop purchasing this
